progress_coordinate.page_log: 0.01 per observed manuscript page, capped at 0.19
progress_coordinate.note: Retouch is excluded. Direct progress is retained separately from the order-inferred readiness floor used by B(t).

all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.delta_c: target publication coordinate minus event coordinate
all_pairs_coordinate_likelihood.note: All coordinate pairs inform each historical batch component; components, not pairs, are averaged.

known_absent_issues.source: X reports; primary source not located

slowest_observed_countdown.interpretation: slowest observed envelope; not a maximum possible wait

no_start_update: The posterior support is conditioned through each issue publicly known not to contain the batch. The analog-fade likelihood is held at the latest production-event issue until a record hiatus.

within_batch_schedule.evidence: Fourteen of fifteen completed modeling-era batches were consecutive; both exceptional intervals occurred in the same remaining batch.

next_batch.evidence: The Level 1 gap prior convolved with the direct predecessor posterior. Following-batch production events are not reused here.

correlation_note: Each historical batch contributes ONE feasibility ramp. The ordered chapter states summarise correlated tweets; treating chapters or events as independent would badly over-sharpen the posterior. Direct observations and order-inferred floors remain separately recorded.
